python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace, createparser, main, process

print('=== R1: Immutability ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
for attr in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
    try:
        setattr(v, attr, 9)
        print(f'FAIL: {attr} should be immutable')
    except AttributeError:
        print(f'OK: {attr} is immutable')

print()
print('=== R2: Iteration ===')
values = list(v)
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1']
print(f'Values: {values}')
print(f'Expected: {expected}')
print(f'Match: {values == expected}')

print()
print('=== R3: Tuple comparison ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print(f'v == (1,2,3,alpha,build.1): {v == (1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build.1\")}')
print(f'v < (2,0,0,None,None): {v < (2, 0, 0, None, None)}')
print(f'v > (1,1,2,beta,build.2): {v > (1, 1, 2, \"beta\", \"build.2\")}')
# String comparison should return NotImplemented
try:
    result = v < '1.2.3'
    print(f'String comparison raised error or returned: {result}')
except TypeError as e:
    print(f'String comparison correctly raises TypeError')

print()
print('=== R4: Bump methods ===')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print(f'bump_major: {v.bump_major()}')
print(f'bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}')
print(f'bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}')
print(f'bump_prerelease: {v.bump_prerelease()}')
print(f'bump_build: {v.bump_build()}')

print()
print('=== R5: Type conversion ===')
v = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', prerelease=123, build=456)
print(f'major type: {type(v.major).__name__}, value: {v.major}')
print(f'minor type: {type(v.minor).__name__}, value: {v.minor}')
print(f'patch type: {type(v.patch).__name__}, value: {v.patch}')
print(f'prerelease type: {type(v.prerelease).__name__}, value: {repr(v.prerelease)}')
print(f'build type: {type(v.build).__name__}, value: {repr(v.build)}')

print()
print('=== R6: CLI functions ===')
print(f'createparser exists: {callable(createparser)}')
print(f'main exists: {callable(main)}')
print(f'process exists: {callable(process)}')

print()
print('=== R7: Replace function and method ===')
print(f'replace function: {replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", major=2)}')
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print(f'VersionInfo.replace method: {v.replace(major=5, minor=6)}')
"
